summary: ai-gateway-payload-processing is a Kubernetes component. managing 2 CRD(s): ExternalModel, ExternalProvider. watching 4 resource type(s). defining 2 API spec type(s) across 14 struct(s) with 48 total fields. with 148 operator config constants. reporting 1 status condition types. integrates with management relationship via labels/annotations.
